evals.prompt: 我准备用 Godot 4.6 开始做一个 2D 弹球游戏，工程目录已经建好了，帮我初始化 AI Harness 工作流环境，让 Claude 可以通过 MCP 控制 Godot
evals.expected_output: 完整的初始化流程：检查环境、godot-mcp 安装、.mcp.json 创建、autoload 注册指引、CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/progress.md 创建、MCP 连接验证

assertions.description: Response mentions .mcp.json as the MCP config file
Response includes step to install/register McpInteractionServer autoload in Godot
Response includes CLAUDE.md (and ideally AGENTS.md) as files to create
Response warns that runtime tools require MCP run_project (not manual Godot launch)
Response correctly states MCP config goes in .mcp.json NOT settings.json/settings.local.json
Response mentions the sibling directory convention for godot-mcp (../godot-mcp/)
Response is structured in numbered phases (Phase 1, Phase 2, etc.)
Response includes a table of known pitfalls/gotchas
Response includes an initial git commit step
Response includes how to verify MCP connection (get_godot_version or game_screenshot)
